metadata.title: API Integration and Client Service Layer

story.iWant: a centralized API client service that handles authentication, error handling, and request/response
story.soThat: components can easily call APIs without repetitive boilerplate

tasks.task: Create ApiClient service with base HTTP methods (AC: #1)
Implement JWT token attachment to requests (AC: #2)
Implement retry logic with exponential backoff (AC: #4)
Implement correlation ID generation and propagation (AC: #7)
Create CustomerService wrapper with customer-specific methods (AC: #9)
Write unit tests for ApiClient and services
Document API client usage with examples

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: ApiClient service created with methods: get, post, put, delete (generic types for type safety)
Automatically attaches JWT token to Authorization header: "Authorization: Bearer {token}"
Handles response status codes: 2xx resolve, 4xx throw error with field-level details, 5xx throw error with message
Retry logic for transient failures: Max 3 retries with exponential backoff (100ms, 200ms, 400ms). Retry on 408, 429, 5xx. Don't retry on 4xx validation errors
Handles 401 Unauthorized (token expired): Attempt to refresh token. If refresh fails, redirect to /login
Logging in development mode (console.log all API calls with timing)
Correlation ID (X-Trace-Id header) included in all requests (UUID)
CustomerService wrapper: createCustomer, getCustomer, searchCustomers, updateCustomer, deleteCustomer methods
PolicyService wrapper (for future use): similar methods for policy operations
Error handling wrapper for common error scenarios: duplicate email, validation errors, network errors, server errors
Usage example in components showing how to call API methods

constraint.rule: Use Axios HTTP client for request/response handling. Configure interceptors for JWT attachment, error handling, and retry logic.
Get JWT from AuthContext via useAuth() hook. Attach to every request in Authorization header as "Bearer {token}". Handle 401 by refreshing token.
Implement exponential backoff: 1st retry after 100ms, 2nd after 200ms, 3rd after 400ms. Don't retry 4xx errors (validation). Retry 5xx and timeout (408, 429).
Backend returns error responses with structure: {error: {code, message, details: [{field, message, value, code}]}}. Parse this and throw typed errors.
Generate UUID for each request (or accept from header). Attach as X-Trace-Id header. Log with all console messages for distributed tracing.
In development mode, log to console: method, URL, status code, response time. Production mode: silent or minimal logging.
On 401 Unauthorized: call POST /api/v1/auth/refresh, get new token, update AuthContext, retry original request. If refresh fails, redirect to /login.
Create CustomerService and PolicyService as wrappers around ApiClient. Each method maps domain operations to API endpoints with type-safe request/response types.

interface.name: ApiClient Service
interface.signature: class ApiClient { get<T>(url, options?), post<T>(url, body, options?), put<T>(url, body, options?), delete<T>(url, options?) }
interface.description: Core HTTP client providing generic methods for making API requests with JWT authentication, retry logic, error handling, and logging.

interface.name: CustomerService Wrapper
interface.signature: class CustomerService { createCustomer(data), getCustomer(id), searchCustomers(query), updateCustomer(id, data), deleteCustomer(id) }
interface.description: Domain-specific service wrapper providing customer-specific methods built on top of ApiClient. Called by UI components.

interface.name: Error Types
interface.signature: class ApiError, ValidationError, NetworkError, etc. - custom error types for different failure scenarios
interface.description: Custom error types for different API failure scenarios. Components can catch and handle specific error types appropriately.

interface.name: Request/Response Types
interface.signature: interface CreateCustomerRequest, UpdateCustomerRequest, SearchQuery, Customer, Policy, etc.
interface.description: Type-safe request and response schemas corresponding to backend API contracts.

interface.name: Axios Interceptors
interface.signature: Request interceptor: attach JWT token, correlation ID. Response interceptor: handle errors, retry logic, token refresh
interface.description: Axios interceptors configured to centralize JWT attachment, error handling, and retry logic for all API requests.

tests.standards: Unit tests use Jest + React Testing Library. Mock Axios to test request/response handling, retry logic, error scenarios, and token refresh flow. Integration tests verify service method behavior with mocked backend.

locations.location: src/services/api/__tests__/interceptors.test.ts - Interceptor logic tests (JWT, retry, error handling)

ideas.idea: Verify ApiClient methods (get, post, put, delete) accept correct parameters and return typed promises
Verify JWT token attached to Authorization header on every request (mock axios and inspect headers)
Verify 2xx responses resolved with parsed JSON, 4xx/5xx throw errors
Verify retry logic: attempts max 3 times with correct backoff timing, doesn't retry 4xx errors
Verify 401 triggers token refresh; original request retried with new token
Verify console.log calls in dev mode show API method, URL, status, timing
Verify X-Trace-Id header present on all requests with UUID format
Verify timeout configured correctly (default 15s, can override per request)
Verify CustomerService methods call correct API endpoints with correct parameters
Verify PolicyService methods exist and call correct API endpoints
Verify error types created for: ValidationError, NetworkError, DuplicateError, ServerError
